blurb: Sprague Rod and Gun Club offers facilities including outdoor rifle ranges, skeet fields, an indoor .22 caliber rimfire range, and a large outdoor pistol range. They host practical shooting matches, pistol league competitions, and skeet shooting teams. The club also has a clubhouse with a bar and hall for members.
extraNote: Pre-registration required for practical shooting matches via Practiscore · Clubhouse at 90 Bushnell Hollow Road, Baltic, CT
